bootstrap.method: paired circular block bootstrap of monthly net-return differences

candidate.labor_market_gate: Sahm gap at t-2 >= 0.50 percentage points
candidate.position: long if both Gold momentum and Sahm gate pass; otherwise flat
candidate.sahm_gap: mean(U3_s,U3_(s-1),U3_(s-2)) minus minimum of prior 12 three-month means
candidate.u3_reference_month_s: decision month t minus two full calendar months

comparators.veto9: frozen 9-month Gold trend with 12-month H.10 USD veto

u3_source.vintage_status: pinned revised historical snapshot; point-in-time vintages unavailable
